text: 因为生育比较困难了。
en: Because having children is comparatively difficult now.

text: 男方如果二婚，要不要孩子无所谓，反倒不太在乎女方年龄，比较重视相处的感觉。
en: If the man is remarrying, whether to have children or not makes no difference; on the contrary, he cares little about the woman's age and values more the feeling of getting along.

text: 真正经历过婚姻的人，基本上都懂，还是相处融洽比较重要。
en: Those who have genuinely been through marriage basically all understand that getting along harmoniously is what matters more.

text: 经济条件好，女方身体素质好，40岁生孩子，现在的医学水平，也是没问题的。
en: If the financial situation is good and the woman's physical constitution is good, having a child at 40 is no problem given today's medical standards.

text: 但是，经济条件差，反而一些辅助手段和症状的应对，会造成沉重的负担。
en: But if the financial situation is poor, then certain assisted means and the management of symptoms will instead create a heavy burden.

text: 很多人结婚的一个重要目的，还是希望能够有个孩子的。
en: An important purpose for many people in marrying is still the hope of having a child.

text: 那种所谓丁克的，现实中很多都是男方不育，或者是双方不孕不育。
en: Those so-called DINKs, in reality many of them are cases where the man is infertile, or both parties are infertile.

text: 如果是女方单方面的问题，且试管解决不了，如果男方经济条件还不错，很多都会离了换新人的。
en: If the problem lies solely with the woman, and IVF cannot resolve it, and the man's financial situation is still fairly good, many will divorce and find a new partner.

text: 人类，到了一定年龄，繁殖欲望会觉醒。
en: Human beings, upon reaching a certain age, will have their reproductive desire awaken.

text: 一个高情商的人，应该懂得，他人的决定，咱外人不能置喙。
en: A person of high emotional intelligence should understand that we outsiders cannot comment on others' decisions.

text: 实际上，我内心真的觉得女孩子在那标榜什么不婚不育挺中二的。
en: Actually, deep down I really feel it is rather chuunibyou for girls to go around proclaiming their refusal to marry or have children.

text: 不婚可以，但是主动不育，很容易后悔，关键是，女孩子，错过了年龄，后悔也没有用了。
en: Not marrying is acceptable, but voluntarily remaining childless easily leads to regret; the key is that, for girls, once the age has passed, regret is of no use.

text: 哪怕是试管，也主要是女方在受罪，打一堆针，各种检查、化验。
en: Even with IVF, it is mainly the woman who suffers — getting a load of injections, all sorts of examinations and tests.

text: 岁数大了生孩子，就是对女性的身体有很大的损伤，这不是搞意识形态就能改变的事实。
en: Having children at an older age genuinely causes great harm to a woman's body; this is a fact that cannot be changed by engaging in ideology.

text: 而且，生孩子这事儿，非常忌讳男女双方年龄都大。
en: Moreover, with having children, it is greatly to be avoided for both man and woman to be old in age.

text: 女性奔四了，想生孩子，找对象，诚心建议，也尽量找年纪小一些的，哪怕他经济条件不太行。
en: For a woman approaching forty who wants to have children and find a partner, my sincere advice is also to try to find someone a bit younger, even if his financial situation is not strong.

text: 人们天天盯着女性的年龄在喷，反而让人们忽略了男性也会老去这个事实。
en: People stare at women's age every day and rail against it, which instead makes people overlook the fact that men also grow old.

text: “男性35+生育能力也会明显下降”，肯定一堆人跳着脚反驳，就当个笑话听吧！
en: 'A man's fertility also declines markedly after 35+' — certainly a bunch of people will jump up and refute this; just take it as a joke!

text: 除了个别精力旺盛异于常人的贪官，可以搞出一堆情妇和孩子，正常男性，哪怕是大佬，也没有多少四五十还在生孩子的。
en: Except for a few corrupt officials with unusual, superhuman energy who can produce a bunch of mistresses and children, normal men — even big shots — few are still having children in their forties or fifties.

text: 男人七十也能生，那是理论上。
en: A man being able to father children at seventy is theoretical.

text: 现实中，确实还有60生孩子的女性呢，但是这种特例，不具备普遍借鉴意义。
en: In reality, there genuinely are women who give birth at 60, but such exceptions have no general reference value.

text: 一顿操作猛如虎，那都是要花钱的。
en: A flurry of moves fierce as a tiger — all of that costs money.

text: 如果身体不是很强健的，40+生孩子也确实风险有些高。
en: If one's body is not very robust, having children past 40 does carry rather high risks.

text: 40岁男的，如果条件好的，有很多30来岁的要，
en: A 40-year-old man, if his conditions are good, has many women in their early thirties who want him,

text: 如果条件差的老光棍，40岁女的也看不上。
en: whereas a poor old bachelor — even a 40-year-old woman would not fancy him.

text: 此外40岁女的绝大多数经历过多，没感情。
en: Moreover, the vast majority of 40-year-old women have too much experience and lack feeling.

text: 物质，现实，找你或是找长期饭票，想拎包入住，
en: Materialistic and pragmatic — they look for you or look for a long-term meal ticket, wanting to move in with just a bag,

text: 你玩那些都是人家玩剩的。
en: the tricks you play at, others have long since played them out.

text: 离异的起码一半有各种问题：情绪不稳定，脾气暴躁，出轨，好吃懒做，爱幻想，自私
en: At least half of those who are divorced have various problems: emotional instability, a violent temper, infidelity, gluttony and laziness, a fondness for fantasy, selfishness.

text: 长期单身的，估计早就成了公交车
en: Those who have been single for a long time have probably long since become a bus.

text: 当然也有少部分优秀的，性格也好的，但几率太低了
en: Of course there is also a small minority who are excellent and of good character, but the probability is too low.

text: 有个很老很老的外国小笑话———
en: There is a very, very old foreign little joke ———

text: 甲：我老婆四十岁了，…
en: A: My wife is forty years old, …

text: 乙：为啥不换两个二十岁的呢？
en: B: Why not swap her for two twenty-year-olds?

text: 这个小笑话告诉我们：不仅中国如此，外国也如此；不仅现在如此，过去也如此。
en: This little joke tells us: not only is it so in China, but also abroad; not only now, but also in the past.

text: 没办法。
en: There is no helping it.

text: 为什么只要条件允许的男人，一定要尽量找年龄小的女人？
en: Why is it that men, as long as their conditions allow, must try their best to find younger women?

text: 是因为年龄小的女人好骗么？
en: Is it because younger women are easy to deceive?

text: 这当然是大龄剩女得不到爱情——而对真正的爱情的嫉妒和诽谤。
en: This is of course the jealousy and slander, towards true love, of older leftover women who cannot obtain love.

text: 实际上和骗不骗没有任何关系。
en: In reality it has nothing to do with whether one deceives or not.

text: 这个逻辑——完全是市场决定的，完全是理智的、聪明的，甚至是被迫的。
en: This logic is entirely decided by the market; it is entirely rational, clever, and even forced.

text: 要永远记住，一个社会所有的组织形态、文明方式和大多数人的选择——其实只是一个结果而已，并不是原因，而真正的原因其实是——在长期的、动态的、市场环境中，所有人不断地选择、然后产生反馈、然后每个人得到反馈、再反馈给其他人之后的结果。
en: Always remember: all the organisational forms of a society, its civilisational modes, and the choices of most people — are in fact merely a result, not a cause; and the true cause is in fact — the result, within a long-term, dynamic, market environment, of everyone constantly choosing, then generating feedback, then each person receiving feedback, and then feeding it back to others.

text: 真正的原因其实是市场。
en: The true cause is in fact the market.

text: 你看到的只是结果，并不是原因。
en: What you see is only the result, not the cause.

text: 或者你看到的原因只是表层的原因，并不是真正彻底的原因。
en: Or the cause you see is only a superficial cause, not the truly fundamental cause.

text: 那么真正的原因是什么？
en: Then what is the true cause?

text: 为什么只要在条件允许的情况下，除非他自己条件根本不允许，否则条件好的男人一定要找年龄小的女人呢？
en: Why is it that, as long as conditions permit, unless his own conditions simply do not allow it, a man with good conditions must find a younger woman?

text: 第1——从人性的角度来说。
en: First — from the perspective of human nature.

text: 人年龄越大，可塑性越差，而不是相反。
en: The older a person is, the worse their plasticity, not the opposite.

text: 江山易改本性难移，人的潜力其实上和年龄是成反比的，而不是相反的。
en: Rivers and mountains may be easy to change, but one's nature is hard to alter; a person's potential is in fact inversely proportional to age, not the opposite.

text: 这个潜力不仅仅是做事业的潜力，当然也包括了爱一个人的潜力，也包括了生孩子的潜力。
en: This potential is not only the potential to build a career, but of course also includes the potential to love someone and the potential to bear children.

text: 人是很难改变自己的——除非你还年轻。
en: It is very difficult for a person to change themselves — unless you are still young.

text: 正常来说，我们认为人的价值观是15岁到20岁决定的，最晚到大学毕业，到了25岁就会完全定型，再改变的只是人的某些细节想法，但是基础的性格和价值观，肯定已经完全定型了。
en: Normally, we believe a person's values are formed between 15 and 20, at the latest by university graduation; by 25 they are completely set, and what changes afterwards are only certain minor thoughts, but the basic character and values are certainly already fully formed.

text: 你不可能指望一个40岁的人，甚至是30岁的人去改变自己的价值观。
en: You cannot expect a 40-year-old, or even a 30-year-old, to change their values.

text: 因此年龄越大的人越固执。
en: Therefore the older a person is, the more stubborn they are.

text: 谁愿意和一个固执的人在一起呢？
en: Who would want to be with a stubborn person?

text: 那么如果是男人年龄大，不也很固执吗？
en: Then if it is the man who is older, isn't he also very stubborn?

text: 是的。
en: Yes.

text: 但是这点后面再说。
en: But we shall discuss this point later.

text: 第2——从感情的角度来说。
en: Second — from the perspective of feelings.

text: 一个人年龄越大，经历过的感情就会越多，而一个人经历过的感情越多——越不会相信真感情。
en: The older a person is, the more relationships they have experienced, and the more relationships a person has experienced, the less they believe in true feeling.

text: 他在感情方面就会变得更加的市侩和精明。
en: He will become more mercenary and shrewd in matters of the heart.

text: 任何一个人谈感情，都是希望有回报的，不管这个回报是——家庭、还是孩子、还是情绪、还是能够长期在一起的预期。
en: Anyone who talks of feelings hopes for a return, whether that return is — family, or children, or emotion, or the expectation of being together long-term.

text: 而一旦一个人非常的市侩和精明，这个成本就会飙升，预期就会非常的不稳定。
en: And once a person is very mercenary and shrewd, the cost soars and the expectation becomes very unstable.

text: 你很难相信一个年龄大的人还相信爱情。
en: It is hard to believe that an older person still believes in love.

text: 如果一个人和你在一起，你付出了很多，尤其是付出了很多钱，他居然骨子里根本不相信和你的爱情，你会怎么想呢？
en: If a person is with you, you have given a great deal, especially a great deal of money, and they fundamentally do not believe in love with you at heart, what would you think?

text: 那么如果是男人年龄大，不也不相信爱情吗？
en: Then if it is the man who is older, doesn't he also not believe in love?

text: 是的。
en: Yes.

text: 但是这点后面再说。
en: But we shall discuss this point later.

text: 第3——从感情的耐受期来说。
en: Third — from the perspective of the endurance period of a relationship.

text: 我们会发现，年龄越大的人，不管男女，只要是大龄的人相亲，越现实——基本上就是直接问工作，赚多少钱，有没有房子车子什么的。
en: We find that the older a person is, regardless of gender, as long as they are older and going on blind dates, the more realistic they are — basically they directly ask about work, how much you earn, whether you have a house or car, and so on.

text: 这个是不分男女的。
en: This applies regardless of gender.

text: 但是，年龄越小的人，她的耐受期是越长的——也就是说，如果你找一个30岁的女人，她跟你谈恋爱，可能直接上来就要彩礼要车子要房子要手表了，但是一个年龄小的女人，她愿意给这段感情更长的时间，去相互考察，彼此确认。
en: But the younger a person is, the longer her endurance period — that is to say, if you find a 30-year-old woman, when she dates you she may straight away demand bride price, a car, a house, a watch; but a younger woman is willing to give the relationship more time, to get to know each other and confirm mutual commitment.

text: 你要明白一个道理——其实任何好的感情，都是需要一段时间的彼此适应、磨合和确认的过程的。
en: You must understand one principle — in fact any good relationship requires a period of mutual adaptation, adjustment and confirmation.

text: 这对男人来说——是相对安全的。
en: For a man, this is relatively safe.

text: 你没看错，男人也是需要安全感的。
en: You read that right — men also need a sense of security.

text: 当然女人也是需要安全感的，而年龄越大的女人，越需要男人快速付出更多钱，来确认自己的安全感。
en: Of course women also need a sense of security, and the older a woman is, the more she needs a man to pay out more money quickly to confirm her sense of security.

text: 所以这是一个博弈的过程。
en: So this is a strategic game.

text: 第4——从价值的角度来说。
en: Fourth — from the perspective of value.

text: 男性在两性关系中，主要提供经济价值，女性主要提供性价值和生育价值。
en: In a relationship between the sexes, men mainly provide economic value, and women mainly provide sexual value and reproductive value.

text: 无论你怎么美化爱情——本质上就是这样的。
en: No matter how you beautify love — this is what it is in essence.

text: 那就是综合条件越好的男人，对女人的性价值和生育价值要求越高，综合条件越好的女人，对男人的经济价值要求越高。
en: That is, the better a man's overall conditions, the higher his demands on a woman's sexual and reproductive value; the better a woman's overall conditions, the higher her demands on a man's economic value.

text: 但是这里请注意——我说的是综合条件，不仅仅是男人有钱和女人长得漂亮。
en: But please note here — I am talking about overall conditions, not merely that the man is rich and the woman is beautiful.

text: 如果你是一个男人，但是你已经50岁了，那除非你非常的有名气和非常的有钱，可以填补你年龄大的缺陷，否则即使你只是有钱，你的综合条件也是没有张艺谋好的。
en: If you are a man but already 50, then unless you are very famous and very rich, able to make up for the defect of your age, otherwise even if you are merely rich, your overall conditions are not as good as Yimou Zhang's.

text: 因为张艺谋是又有钱、又有名气，虽然他找陈婷的时候已经快50岁了。
en: Because Yimou Zhang is both rich and famous, even though he was nearly 50 when he got together with Ting Chen.

text: 同样的，张柏芝、伊能静这些人，能在二婚的时候、甚至是已经有孩子的时候，依然能够找到富豪或者找到男明星结婚，前提并不仅仅是长得漂亮，和她们的阶层高度相关——因为她们是女明星。
en: Similarly, people like Boxin Zhang and Nengjing Yi, able to find wealthy men or male celebrities to marry even when remarrying, or even when they already had children, the premise is not merely being beautiful — it is highly related to their class, because they are female celebrities.

text: 所以如果是对于普通人来说——男人要尽量早点有钱，女人要尽量早点找到合适的、更有钱的、爱自己的男人。
en: So for ordinary people — men should try to become wealthy early, and women should try to find a suitable, wealthier man who loves them early.

text: 第5——从经济协作的角度来说。
en: Fifth — from the perspective of economic cooperation.

text: 这也是我们上面说的，男人年龄大也固执，男人年龄大综合价值也会降低——但是这里要注意一点。
en: This is also what we said above: an older man is also stubborn, and an older man's overall value also declines — but here one point must be noted.

text: 要非常注意。
en: Pay very close attention.

text: 那就是至少在中国，整体来说，在两性关系中，你越是有钱，你在两性关系中肯定越是掏大头的，说白了就是你掏钱。
en: That is, at least in China, overall, in relationships between the sexes, the richer you are, the more surely you foot the larger share — plainly speaking, you pay.

text: 而在中国的资源分配模式中——钱是非常稀缺的资源，几乎没有任何其他资源可以比拟。
en: And in China's model of resource distribution — money is a very scarce resource, with almost no other resource comparable to it.

text: 那么这就决定了有钱的稀缺性极高。
en: Then this determines that the scarcity of being wealthy is extremely high.

text: 尤其是当他年龄不太大、其他条件也不差的时候。
en: Especially when his age is not too great and his other conditions are not poor.

text: 同样是花钱——为什么不给一个年龄更小、更漂亮的人花钱呢？
en: Spending money all the same — why not spend it on someone younger and more beautiful?

text: 为什么要给一个可能根本不爱自己、还索求无度的人花钱呢？
en: Why spend money on someone who may not love you at all and is endlessly demanding?

text: 当然，这是有钱男人的思维。
en: Of course, this is the thinking of a wealthy man.

text: 没钱的男人，能找到个人愿意嫁给他、愿意生孩子就不错了。
en: A man without money is lucky just to find someone willing to marry him and bear his children.
